account.title: Your details
account.description: Your name is yours to change. Your email address is what you sign in with, so changing it is not something we can do from here yet.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs you out everywhere else and leaves this device signed in.
password.note: You will be asked for your current password, even though you are signed in. Your other devices stay signed out until you use the new password on them.

dialog.title: Change your password
dialog.description: Signing out your other devices is the point of a password change, so it is not optional. Nothing will ask you to change it again afterwards.

currentPassword.label: Current password
currentPassword.description: Required even though you are signed in — someone who found this tab open must not be able to set a new password.

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.description: Every other device is signed out. This one stays signed in.

outcomes.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Every other device was signed out; this one stays.
